Name: Ryu
Bio: Raised by Gouken from childhood, Ryu lives only for the fight itself - no titles, no prize money, just the next opponent and the next lesson. His calm hides a constant battle with the Satsui no Hado, the killing intent that sleeps inside his own fists.

Name: Ken
Bio: Heir to the Masters fortune and Ryu's brother-in-arms, Ken trained alongside him under Gouken. Where Ryu is stillness, Ken is fire: flashier, louder and every bit as dangerous, with a Shoryuken that burns.

Name: Chun-Li
Tagline: The strongest woman in the world
Bio: An Interpol officer hunting the man who murdered her father - M. Bison. Her legs are the fastest in the tournament, and her Kikoken and Lightning Legs have ended more Shadaloo careers than any warrant.

Name: Guile
Bio: A U.S. Air Force major who entered the tournament for one reason: revenge on Bison for the death of his best friend, Charlie Nash. Patient, defensive and relentless, he waits for you to jump.

Name: Blanka
Bio: A boy who survived a plane crash and grew up in the Amazon, Blanka's body changed in the wild. He bites, rolls and sends electricity through his skin - but under the green is a gentle soul looking for his mother.

Name: Zangief
Bio: A wrestler who trains by fighting bears in the Siberian snow. Zangief fights for the glory of his motherland and wants to prove that his muscles can stop any fireball.

Name: E. Honda
Tagline: The sumo of a hundred hands
Bio: A yokozuna who enters the tournament to show the world that sumo is the greatest martial art. His Hundred Hand Slap is exactly what it sounds like.

Name: Dhalsim
Bio: A pacifist yoga master who fights only to raise money for his village. Through meditation he can stretch his limbs, breathe fire and float across the arena.

Name: Balrog
Bio: A banned heavyweight boxer turned Shadaloo enforcer. Balrog fights for money and only money, and his Dash Straight crosses the screen before you can blink.

Name: Vega
Bio: A narcissistic Spanish nobleman who blends bullfighting with ninjutsu. Behind the mask and the claw he is Shadaloo's most vain assassin - he hides his face so it can't be scratched.

Name: Sagat
Bio: The former world champion carries Ryu's Shoryuken as a scar across his chest. After joining Shadaloo for a rematch, he slowly trades revenge for honour - and becomes the rival Ryu respects most.

Name: M. Bison
Bio: Leader of Shadaloo and master of Psycho Power. Bison discarded his conscience to become something more than human and treats the World Warrior tournament as a hunting ground for new bodies.

Name: Cammy
Bio: Created by Shadaloo as one of Bison's Dolls and later freed, Cammy now serves with Delta Red. She has no memory of her past, only razor reflexes and a Cannon Spike.

Name: Fei Long
Bio: A kung fu movie star who wants to prove that his on-screen skills are real. Fast, fierce and theatrical, he strings together his Rekka punches like a fight choreography.

Name: Dee Jay
Bio: A kickboxer and musician who fights to find a new rhythm for his music. He is always smiling, always dancing, and his Max Out sends sonic waves across the arena.

Name: T. Hawk
Bio: A giant of a man who fights to take back his people's homeland from Shadaloo. His Condor Dive drops from the sky, and once he grabs you, the round is usually over.
